notes: PINNED decoding parameters for the NoaCG Pro Phase 0 spike (docs/NOACG_PRO_PLAN.md §0.1: 'decoding parameters pinned in the fixtures'). A round whose sampling settings are implicit cannot be repeated, and 'the model got worse' has been the wrong answer to a settings change before. scripts/pro-spike.mjs reads this file and records the values it used into results.json, so a round carries its own settings rather than depending on this file staying still.

rationale.temperature: The spike asks whether the model has design taste, not whether it can be forced into one deterministic answer. Greedy decoding (0) suppresses exactly the variety §0.3 measures ('at least 3 genuinely different visual directions'), so a mid temperature is the honest setting for the question. It is the same value across both arms and both checkpoints - the arms differ in the exemplar block and in nothing else.
rationale.seed: Fixed so a re-run of a disputed brief reproduces the same sample where the endpoint honours seeds. Many gateway endpoints ignore it; that is a property of the endpoint, and the run records what came back rather than assuming reproducibility.
rationale.expectedOutputTokens: A complete three-file SPX template (document + rich commented CSS + the animation region) runs long. outputBudget() adds the reasoning headroom on top. A truncated emit reads as a broken model, so this is set well above the largest catalog design's own three files rather than tuned down for cost.
